paragraphs: The E-Pace P160 uses the Ingenium AJ150 — a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted from the model's launch in 2017 through to the end of production in 2024 across the X540 generation. The P160 sat as the entry point to the E-Pace petrol range, with the P200 and P250 offering higher-output versions of the same 2.0-litre Ingenium engine family. The E-Pace P160 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the E-Pace P160 from 2023 to present. The AJ150 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ150 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ150 rebuild.
